{{- define "llms_print_section" -}}
{{- $section := .section -}}
{{- $depth := .depth -}}
{{- if or (gt (len $section.RegularPages) 0) (gt (len $section.Sections) 0) -}}
{{- $hashes := strings.Repeat (add $depth 1) "#" }}

{{ printf "%s %s" $hashes $section.Title }}

{{- range $page := $section.RegularPages }}
  {{- if and (not $page.Params.searchHidden) (ne $page.Layout "archives") (ne $page.Layout "search") }}
- [{{ $page.Title }}]({{ $page.Permalink }})
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- range $subsection := $section.Sections -}}
{{- template "llms_print_section" (dict "section" $subsection "depth" (add $depth 1)) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

# {{ site.Title }}

{{- $orphans := where site.RegularPages "Section" "" -}}
{{- if gt (len $orphans) 0 }}
{{- range $page := $orphans -}}
  {{- if and (not $page.Params.searchHidden) (ne $page.Layout "archives") (ne $page.Layout "search") (not $page.IsHome) }}
- [{{ $page.Title }}]({{ $page.Permalink }})
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- range site.Sections -}}
{{- template "llms_print_section" (dict "section" . "depth" 1) -}}
{{- end }}
